note: Agent-proposed bounded WP3B envelope; see docs/workstreams/wp3b-owner-export-linking-v1alpha4.md. Frozen Harness profile still lists WP3B as maintainer-queued; this inventory records the executed fixtures for Draft PR review.

fixtures.title: Positive ToolCatalog/Schema export identity and trusted Owner attribution
fixtures.input: Appendix E.1-E.4 baseline with one accepted single-Owner Host Context snapshot and one accepted single-Owner ToolCatalog snapshot.
assertions: No WP3B diagnostic is emitted.
Every referenced callable, Schema and Evidence Guarantee export is indexed exactly once with its trusted Owner.
Callable kind, Effect, Schema references and Owner Outcomes are retained for later work packages.
Later unimplemented stages still fail closed; Build is not expected to succeed.
Snapshot file ordering does not change attribution or diagnostics.

fixtures.title: ToolCatalog metadata.owner is not a trusted authorized Owner
fixtures.input: Change the ToolCatalog metadata.owner to example-untrusted-owner; recompute the snapshot digest and binding digest.
assertions: Exactly one DEPENDENCY_OWNER_MISMATCH/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic uses an empty path and zero line/column (imported-contract failure).
No Owner is inferred from a filename or display name.
Build remains failure-atomic.

fixtures.title: Multi-Owner snapshot lacks attribution for a referenced export
fixtures.input: Use the Appendix E multi-Owner baseline (two authorized Owners plus explicit attribution for every referenced export), then remove the attribution for the referenced registration Schema.
assertions: The valid multi-Owner baseline links without a WP3B diagnostic.
Exactly one DEPENDENCY_EXPORT_OWNER_UNVERIFIED/C_STATIC is emitted for the missing attribution.
The diagnostic uses an empty path and zero line/column.
First-match or single-Owner fallback is not attempted.

fixtures.title: Unique trusted attribution names an unauthorized Owner
fixtures.input: Use the Appendix E multi-Owner baseline and change the registration Schema attribution Owner to example-untrusted-owner.
assertions: Exactly one DEPENDENCY_OWNER_MISMATCH/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic uses an empty path and zero line/column.
The unauthorized Owner is not silently accepted because the export was uniquely attributed.

fixtures.title: Duplicate callable ID across ToolCatalog files in one snapshot
fixtures.input: Add a second valid ToolCatalog file to the trusted ca snapshot declaring the same callable ID ue.registration.current with a different kind.
assertions: Exactly one EXPORT_ID_AMBIGUOUS/C_STATIC is emitted.
Duplicate identity is not resolved by kind, Owner or file order.
The ambiguous identity is not also reported as missing.

fixtures.title: Referenced callable export does not exist
fixtures.input: Change observation.tool to ca::ue.registration.missing while the trusted snapshot is valid.
assertions: Exactly one EXPORT_ID_MISSING/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic retains the original procedure.yaml source path/line/column.
No ExportId is guessed from the catalog file or a prefix.

fixtures.title: Referenced Schema $id does not exist in the selected snapshot
fixtures.input: Change the Predicate parameter QualifiedSchemaId to ca::urn:example:ca:missing:v1.
assertions: Exactly one SCHEMA_MISSING/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic retains the original predicates.yaml source path/line/column.
Schema identity is matched by exact $id, not by file name.

fixtures.title: Callable exists but not with the required kind
fixtures.input: Change the catalog callable from kind observation to kind operation and observation.tool keeps referencing it.
assertions: Exactly one EXPORT_ID_MISSING/C_STATIC is emitted.
An operation export cannot satisfy an Observation reference.
No new diagnostic code is invented for the kind mismatch.

fixtures.title: Duplicate Schema $id in one selected snapshot
fixtures.input: Add a second Schema file to the trusted ca snapshot with the same exact $id urn:example:ca:registration:v1.
assertions: Exactly one EXPORT_ID_AMBIGUOUS/C_STATIC is emitted.
Duplicate Schema identity is not resolved by file order.
The ambiguous Schema is not also reported as missing.
